justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/decoder/ErrorCorrectionLevel.java and core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/decoder/ErrorCorrectionLevelTestCase.java. The class is a compact enum of 4 constants with only 2 small methods (`getBits()` and `forBits()`), about 60 lines total, and it serves a single mapping responsibility for QR error-correction levels. The test file covers just that mapping and invalid-bit handling, which supports a narrow, cohesive design rather than insufficient modularization.
